properties.description: A built capability with no recorded consumer is surfaced, and the report never says "unused". COVERS THE CAPABILITY SIGNAL ONLY — the three consumption edges read (incoming DEPENDS_ON, outgoing PART_OF_FLOW, incoming INTERACTS_WITH), the realized/verified population, discontinued capabilities and discontinued CONSUMERS excluded, the MIN_MODELLED_RATIO withholding rule with its ratio note, MIN_POPULATION, the stated signal boundary, and the wording discipline (the finding may not contain "unused"/"dead"/"delete"/"surplus"/severity, scanned over the OBSERVATIONS so the caveats may still name the failure mode they prevent). DELIBERATELY NOT COVERED: the generalisations the capability's description mentions in passing — a Component whose Interfaces nothing CONSUMES, and an Artifact realizing only unconsumed capabilities. Neither is built, and this check must not be read as standing for them (the ver:sessions-cannot-cross-designs precedent, 2026-08-07: a green check covering a clause it never tested is worse than an absent one).
properties.findings: 15 cases, each mutation-checked — all eight mutations tried (dropping each of the three signals, admitting `planned` to the population, disabling either threshold, and removing either discontinued check) were killed.
